title: Second and third reference media backends
description: Keep the VtcBackend media hooks vendor-neutral by designing against more than AWS. (a) WHEP / SFU-egress backend (e.g. LiveKit egress or another WHEP playback service): sub-second playback, token auth. (b) Free-tools reference backend: ffmpeg (or GStreamer) pushing to a static HLS/DASH origin, no DRM, runnable offline in CI. Sketch both against the hooks before the AWS adapter is finalised; any hook that only fits one backend is a protocol smell to raise on spec epic jmap-chat-spec-xpzz.
